      "id": "def-lkb-two-variable-covering-homomorphism",
      "concern": "The exponent-sum form says that forgetting punctures gives a braid in B2 and identifies its σ1 exponent b with the positive winding exponent. Under the published identification Φgeo(β)=(ι*[S(β)])⁻¹, a raw positive mobile half-rotation loop corresponds to σ1⁻¹: its winding exponent is +1 but its Artin exponent is −1. The same sign issue affects b′ and a=(b′−b)/2. The winding definition itself is coherent. Adjudicate which loop-to-braid identification this paragraph intends; an alternative raw-slicing convention must be stated explicitly rather than silently using the published group isomorphism.",

    },
